name: Possessed Chaos Space Marine

bonuses.name: Architect of Ruin
bonuses.text: The GM gains 1 point of Ruin at the start of each of this Threat's turns.

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: This Threat may use Ruin Actions and has 4 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Writhing Tentacles
bonuses.text: This Threat may Multi-Attack all enemies it is Engaged with without suffering a DN penalty.

abilities.name: Sea of Mutations
abilities.text: The Daemon warps its host's form, preparing it for battle. At the start of any combat with this Threat, apply a Severe Mutation to this Threat. You can roll on the Severe Mutations table (p.288) when this Threat is encountered, or before the session.

abilities.name: Veteran of the Long War
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin to add the game's Tier as ED to all attacks this Threat makes this Round.

abilities.name: Painful Lessons
abilities.text: When this Threat dies, the GM gains 2 Ruin.

determination: Daemonic Determination: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 9d6. Daemons can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds. Any Wounds negated by Determination are ignored instead of being converted to Shock.
